summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for Pan Administrador. BACKEND: 31/31 pytest passing (19 legacy + 12 new taxonomy/dual-intent voice). Verified GET /api/taxonomy seeds defaults (Ropa/Cosméticos/Electrónicos/General each with 7 subcats, expense_types merchandise/supplies/operating), POST/DELETE inventory-category/subcategory + expense-type/category persist correctly; adding a new inventory category with unknown name seeds the 7 GENERIC_SUBCATS. Dual-intent voice/parse with context param verified: 'buscar buzo azul' -> {kind:search,target:inventory}, 'añadir 5 pantalones a 10' -> {kind:add_product,name,stock:5,cost:10,price:null}, 'vendí un buzo a 15000 en efectivo' -> {kind:sale,method:cash,amount:15000}, 'gasté 10000 en pasajes' -> {kind:expense,type:operating,category:Transporte,amount:10000}. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844): register->dashboard->4 bottom tabs all render [Inventario/Ventas/Gastos/Reportes] with raised center mic FAB (voice-fab). TopBar topbar-home & topbar-settings visible on every tab. Inventory: invcat-add + invsub-add + inventory-search all present; Ropa/Cosméticos/Electrónicos chips render (taxonomy load). Expenses: etype-other, method-cash/method-transfer verified; selecting method-transfer reveals 6 subtypes (Transferencia Bancaria, Tarjeta Débito/Crédito, Billetera Digital, POS, PayPal, Otros). Settings: currency-EUR chip + currency-add opens world picker modal, picker-search filters to world-currency-GBP. category-manager reachable via open-category-manager and shows cm-add-inv-cat, cm-add-exp-type, cm-del-cat-Ropa, cm-add-sub-Ropa, cm-del-etype-supplies. Voice modal manual-input flow: 'buscar pantalón' typed into voice-manual-input then voice-manual-submit successfully navigated back to Inventory and pre-filled inventory-search with 'pantalón' (visible on screenshot).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning still present: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — likely from /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx fab styles (shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius, lines 77-80). Migrate to boxShadow for RN-Web.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx line 50 uses pointerEvents="box-none" as prop; move to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: (Low) Migrate deprecated RN-Web props in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx: replace shadow* with boxShadow and prop pointerEvents="box-none" with style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}.
